accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: If given, the first installment is paid from it in this instruction. It may be
`merchant_usdc` when shoppers finance a Solana Pay code to their own account.

accounts.name: asset
docs: Collateral asset the installment is collected from.

accounts.name: asset
docs: Collateral asset to seize.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidLtv
errors.msg: LTV parameters must satisfy max < margin < liquidation < 100%

errors.name: InvalidParam
errors.msg: Invalid protocol parameter

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Price must be greater than zero

errors.name: StalePrice
errors.msg: Oracle price is stale

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Math overflow

errors.name: PositionFull
errors.msg: All collateral slots are in use

errors.name: AssetNotInPosition
errors.msg: Collateral asset not found in position

errors.name: InsufficientCollateral
errors.msg: Not enough collateral deposited

errors.name: MissingAssetAccount
errors.msg: A collateral asset account required for valuation is missing

errors.name: InsufficientCredit
errors.msg: Not enough available credit

errors.name: ExceedsMaxLtv
errors.msg: Withdrawal would exceed the max LTV

errors.name: LoanRepaid
errors.msg: Loan is already fully repaid

errors.name: NotLiquidatable
errors.msg: Position is not liquidatable

errors.name: ExceedsCloseFactor
errors.msg: Repay amount exceeds the close factor

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: Not enough idle liquidity: funds are lent out

errors.name: InvalidPriceUpdate
errors.msg: Invalid Pyth price update account

errors.name: FeedMismatch
errors.msg: Price update is for a different feed

errors.name: PriceUncertain
errors.msg: Oracle confidence interval too wide

errors.name: NotOverdue
errors.msg: Installment is not past its grace period

errors.name: KeeperPricesDisabled
errors.msg: Keeper prices are disabled in this build; use refresh_price

fields.name: price_e6
docs: USD price of one whole token, 6 decimals.

fields.name: pyth_feed_id
docs: Pyth feed id; all zeros means keeper-posted prices only.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Posts oracle prices and runs liquidations.

fields.name: close_factor_bps
docs: Max share of debt a single liquidation may repay.

fields.name: lp_mint
docs: Share token for liquidity providers; pool value = idle liquidity + outstanding debt.

fields.name: late_fee_bps
docs: Charged on an installment paid later than `next_due_at + grace_period`.

fields.name: fees_earned
docs: Lifetime merchant fees + late fees accrued to liquidity providers.

fields.name: unearned_fees
docs: Merchant fees on open loans, earned installment by installment. Excluded
from pool value so LPs cannot capture a fee by depositing around a checkout.

types.name: CreditProfile
docs: On-chain repayment record. Installments paid on time raise the borrower's max LTV
on new purchases, level by level; any late payment, overdue collection or
liquidation resets it. Created on the borrower's first repayment.

fields.name: on_time_repaid
docs: Cash repaid on time since the last reset, excluding the installment due at checkout.

fields.name: on_time_installments
docs: Lifetime count of installments that counted toward `on_time_repaid`.

fields.name: resets
docs: Lifetime count of resets.

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Debt written off because the position has no collateral left.

fields.name: paid
docs: Installment cash the collector paid into the pool on the borrower's behalf.

fields.name: seized
docs: Collateral taken from the borrower, worth `(paid + late_fee) * (1 + liquidation bonus)`.

fields.name: debt
docs: Outstanding debt in USDC base units.

fields.name: credit_balance
docs: Debt already covered by liquidations, consumed by upcoming installments.

constants.name: CREDIT_MARGIN_BUFFER_BPS
docs: A credit-boosted max LTV always stays this far below the asset's margin line.

constants.name: CREDIT_STEP
docs: USDC (base units) repaid on time per credit level.

constants.name: CREDIT_STEP_BPS
docs: Max LTV added per credit level.

constants.name: CREDIT_WINDOW
docs: An installment builds credit only if paid at most this long before its due date,
so a record takes real time to earn instead of one prepayment.
